def nki_softmax_(x):
    R, C = x.shape
    # Allocate output in shared HBM
    out = nl.ndarray((R, C), dtype=x.dtype, buffer=nl.shared_hbm)

    nisa.tensor_scalar(dst=div_tile, data=exp_tile, op0=nl.divide, operand0=sum_vals)
